description:
## Outcome

`jido_cli` resolves `../jidoka` for local development and tests, and an architecture test fails when production CLI source reaches into a Jidoka implementation namespace or task field.

## Why now

The CLI now compiles against Hex `jidoka ~> 0.8.0-beta.1`, while the workspace Jidoka API has newer session and cancellation contracts. Every later cross-repository story needs one tested source of truth.

## Current state

`jido_cli/mix.exs` declares the Hex dependency and `mix.lock` locks it. `test/jido_cli/cli/runtime_test.exs` aliases the old `Jidoka.Harness.Session`. Jidoka classifies `Jidoka.Harness`, `Jidoka.Runtime`, adapters, execution modules, and async task ownership as internal. Most production CLI calls already use `Jidoka`, `Jidoka.Session`, and documented contract structs.

## Ownership and boundary

This is a `jido_cli` change. Jidoka source does not change. Keep the local file dependency during development and test. Document how a release maintainer changes the dependency for package publication, but do not perform a release in this story. The architecture test must allow documented public facades and only the advanced contract modules that the CLI still needs.

## Detailed implementation

1. Change the Jidoka dependency in `jido_cli/mix.exs` to the sibling path and refresh only the Jidoka lock entry.
2. Update tests that assert the obsolete `Jidoka.Harness.Session` type. Use a public facade result or the documented `Jidoka.Session.Data` contract.
3. Add `test/jido_cli/jidoka_public_api_boundary_test.exs`. Parse `lib/jido_cli/**/*.ex` and reject `Jidoka.Adapter`, `Jidoka.Runtime`, `Jidoka.Harness`, `Jidoka.Chat.Async`, `Jidoka.*.Execution`, and direct task-field ownership. Keep a small named allow-list for public contract namespaces.
4. Add source-string fixtures in the test so alias, remote-call, and struct-pattern violations are all detected.
5. Update development documentation with the sibling checkout requirement.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `mix deps` shows Jidoka from `../jidoka` in development and test.
- [ ] No CLI production or test code depends on `Jidoka.Harness.Session`.
- [ ] The boundary test passes on the real `lib/jido_cli` tree.
- [ ] The boundary test fails for representative forbidden aliases, calls, and request task patterns.
- [ ] Public `Jidoka`, `Jidoka.Session`, `Jidoka.Event`, `Jidoka.Stream`, and approved typed contracts remain usable.
- [ ] No Jidoka source file changes.

## Test plan

- Success: resolve dependencies and run the existing runtime, TUI, loader, plan, and engine tests against the sibling checkout.
- Invalid input: feed malformed source text to the boundary scanner and return a clear test failure, not a scanner crash.
- Runtime failure: use existing injected LLM failures; do not call a live model.
- Boundary and security: prove all forbidden namespace forms and `Task.shutdown` ownership fail.
- Deterministic capability: keep current fake LLM and engine injection.
- JSONL and exit status: run existing automation and CLI tests to confirm JSONL and statuses 0, 1, and 64 do not change.

## Documentation

Update `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or a focused development guide. State that sibling Jidoka is the active development contract and that the CLI depends only on public Jidoka APIs.

## Non-goals

Do not publish packages. Do not change a Jidoka public API. Do not migrate the automation turn loop yet. Do not broaden the allow-list to make a violation pass.

## Dependencies

Blocking issues:

- None. This is the first implementation story.

Features unlocked by this story:

- Public Jidoka cancellation in the TUI
- The ordered Jidoka session sequence
- All cross-repository contract tests

## Commit plan

Create exactly one focused `jido_cli` commit. Use a message such as `feat(cli): use the sibling Jidoka public contract (jido_cli-tqg.1.1)`. Do not include another backlog feature.

## Verification commands

```sh
cd /Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_cli/jido_cli
mix deps.get && mix test test/jido_cli/jidoka_public_api_boundary_test.exs test/jido_cli/cli/runtime_test.exs test/jido_cli/cli/automation/engine/jidoka_test.exs
mix quality
mix test --cover
mix docs
```
title: Use the sibling Jidoka checkout as the CLI development contract
